description: Names a resolved data path.
tools: Read

Edit ~/.claude/plugins/data/solokit/defaults.json, or /home/u/.claude/plugins/data/solokit-inline/x.json.
On Windows: C:\Users\u\.claude\plugins\data\solokit\x.json, $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and %CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA%.
The folder ~/.claude/plugins/data itself.
